# The Social Vision

> The Social Vision (TSV) is a London-based short-form content agency. We plan, cast, film, edit and post TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts content for apps and consumer brands, covering organic content and paid ad creative. We are a small, founder-led team.

- Founder: Zahira Jaigirdar, Founder & Creative Director
- Based in: London, United Kingdom. Works with brands across the UK.
- Formats: street interviews, UGC creators on your channels, trend-led content, scripted interactions, UGC-style creatives, educational explainers, hi-fi paid ads
- Platforms: TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. We work in English only.
- What we don’t do: influencer marketing or influencer campaigns, and we don’t offer edit-only work. We make UGC and short-form content with our creators, for the client’s own channels.
- Creator network: 300+ vetted UK creators
- Who we work with: consumer apps, fintech, edtech and student brands, food and drink, health and consumer brands. Clients include Plum, Habito, Uni Compare, TALAB, Blackbullion, Applicaa and Prep Kitchen.
- Pricing: retainers from £2,000 a month (ex VAT), scoped to each brand's goals, formats and content volume, on a 3-month initial term, then rolling with 30 days' notice
- First content live: within 14–21 days of signing
- Organic minimum: 16 videos a month. The paid minimum depends on the budget.
- Creator pay: creators are paid on the 15th of the month
- Revisions: included. The number of rounds is agreed in each brief. If our footage is not good enough, we reshoot at our own cost. A reshoot after a client script change is quoted case by case. Extra work is quoted per project.
- Usage: perpetual usage rights on the content we make. Paid use is not included. Spark Ads, whitelisting and partnership ads need a separate written agreement and creator authorisation.
- Scripts are the default. Talking points are used only if the brief says so.
- High-production and street-interview shoots need 1 week’s notice.
- Shipping: the client ships the product at their cost, and the creator keeps it.
- Regulated brands: nothing goes live until compliance signs off.

## Results

- [Habito](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/case-studies/habito) (digital mortgage broker): 25M+ organic views in 8 months with zero ad spend, average views per video up from about 1,000 to 156,000
- [Uni Compare](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/case-studies/uni-compare) (university comparison platform): 1M+ views in the first 8 weeks, average views per video up from under 1,000 to 83,000
- [TALAB](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/case-studies/talab) (student app): from launch with no audience to 6,000 users, organic short-form content driving most of that growth
- [Plum](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/case-studies/plum) (money app): a dedicated paid social creative partner producing hi-fi ads, UGC-style content and scripted interactions
